name: Thai Coconut Red Curry Soup with Tofu, Mixed Veggies & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
3 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and roughly chop bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.
Halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper along with the broccoli.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add curry paste and veggies; cook, stirring frequently, until veggies start to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, red

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, coconut milk, sugar, and salt to the pot. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2129 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is heating, medium dice tofu.
Once the soup is simmering, add tofu and reduce heat to medium-low. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender and tofu is warmed through, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the soup is done, remove from heat. Add cilantro and vinegar, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
